title: Realization of each finite projection base-change route
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a coefficient datum C with prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and an integer n >= 1. Let S be a six-functor datum [def-sf-datum] at (D,C,E,n), and let Q be a compactified Cartesian square (g prime,f prime,f,g) of its finite-type spaces with the specified compactification c of f. Let K be a bounded constructible finite-coefficient object on X and L a bounded constructible object of finite Tor amplitude on Y, over A_n=O_E/t^n. Use the paths and explicit isomorphisms source,target of [def-sf-finite-base-change-realization-paths], the full inclusion I of the constructible category on Y prime, and the specified realization R there. Put k=R_X.inverse(K) and q=R_Y.inverse(L). Then I(LeftPath);target = source;R(diamondLeft(A_n,Q,c,k,q)) and I(RightPath);target = source;R(diamondRight(A_n,Q,c,k,q)), with the canonical fixed-scalar routes of [def-sf-finite-projection-exchange-coordinates]. These are separate coordinate equations. No separatedness of g or of the structure maps is required.

lean.statement: theorem sixFunctorProjectionFinite_routes_realization (S : SixFunctorDatum D C E n hn) (Q : SixFunctorCompactifiedSquare D) (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn Q.X) (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E n hn Q.Y.obj.left) : letI := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n hn let A := ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n) let RX := CompactSupportFiniteProjection.realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) Q.X let RY := CompactSupportFiniteProjection.realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) Q.Y let R' := CompactSupportFiniteProjection.realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) Q.Y' let I := (intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible C.l E n hn Q.Y'.obj.left).ι let source := sixFunctorProjectionFiniteSquareSource S Q K L let target := sixFunctorProjectionFiniteSquareTarget S Q K L I.map (sixFunctorProjectionFiniteLeftPath S Q K L) ≫ target.hom = source.hom ≫ R'.functor.map (FiniteProjectionExchange.diamondLeft A Q.square Q.compactification (RX.inverse.obj K.obj) (RY.inverse.obj L.obj)) ∧ I.map (sixFunctorProjectionFiniteRightPath S Q K L) ≫ target.hom = source.hom ≫ R'.functor.map (FiniteProjectionExchange.diamondRight A Q.square Q.compactification (RX.inverse.obj K.obj) (RY.inverse.obj L.obj))
